environment.broker: RabbitMQ 4.1.8 disposable vhost and Compose broker
environment.browser: Playwright Chromium against a production frontend image
environment.source: controlled synthetic event and discussion responses; no external source requests or existing MinIO connection

red.assertion: an event member must expose persisted discussion on user action
red.observed: the event dossier had no 查看评论上下文 button and made no detail request

green.client: EventDossiers reuses ContentDiscussion and generated getContentDetail; no handwritten endpoint request
green.lazy_loading: detail request count remained zero before user action and became one generated GET after click
green.rendered_context: controlled root post, parent comment and selected reply were visible inside the event member
green.event_actions: the existing remove-member action remained enabled
green.contract: FastAPI OpenAPI and UmiOpenAPI generated client had no drift
green.dependency_audit: no known Python vulnerabilities; production frontend audit 0
green.frontend: contract, boundary, negative boundary, Prettier and TypeScript/Vite checks passed
green.browser: 9 Chromium tests passed from an empty disposable database
green.old_application_rollback: fixed 0019 application read an isolated old-schema snapshot through a database-enforced read-only role

regression_note: A reused disposable database contained events created by a previous browser run, so the workspace empty-state assertion failed; deleting only this Compose project volumes and rerunning unchanged produced 9 passes. The first remote run also exposed an existing diagnostic-test race: the real prefork worker could finish before the UI observed the controlled queued phase. The POST response is now held at queued by the test route while later generated list reads drive the deterministic terminal sequence; the production request and worker still execute.

first_run.failure: workspace polling test observed the real diagnostic as completed before its controlled queued assertion

limitations: The browser response is controlled and verifies generated-client wiring; it does not prove real platform comment retrieval.
No external platform request, existing MinIO instance, real user content or seven-day observation was used.
This slice advances TASK-007-S04-T01 and CHK-007-G4-002 but does not complete EV-007-004, EV-007-006 or the full P0 goal.
